required_capabilities: local host filesystem and media inspection
mutation_authority: bounded fixes only in media-transcript-acquisition capability through an isolated branch and reviewed pull request
owned_scope: local private output root selected by operator
forbidden_scope: provider/browser credentials, cookies, account sessions and DRM bypass
public Git media, raw transcripts or private host path publication
Task Scheduler registration or live account setting changes
other Automation capabilities, consumer product behavior and protected corporate systems
expected_artifacts: private local video/audio/hybrid file and receipt or typed blocked receipt
reviewed bounded fix if validation exposes a defect
acceptance_gates: sync checkout to integrated branch/main and confirm current commit
run media capability offline unittest suite and note exact test count
validate a real accessible user-authorized YouTube and Instagram URL separately with recorded tool versions
check video/audio playability and receipt SHA-256 against actual files
check provider denial behavior, no secret leakage, and no partial output promoted
certify Windows child-window and fullscreen behavior separately before any unattended scheduling
document current PR/merge status accurately; do not call synthetic proof live
proof_ceiling: Offline source tests and remote CI cannot certify local host installation, external provider access, specific video/audio codecs, or Windows fullscreen silence.
runtime_handoff: Resume from the current branch/PR and receipt schema. Run the bounded checks above; if access is blocked, preserve typed redacted evidence without bypass. Fix only proven defects, rerun affected tests, and report CHANGED | PROVED | NEXT with commit IDs and exact provider/host status.
freshness_requirements: refresh Automation main and open pull request state and verify branch SHA before changes
record fresh local Python yt-dlp and FFmpeg versions
verify authorization and reachability of selected test sources at runtime
